snippet.title: Beastfolk Barber｜Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Beastfolk Barber is officially open! ✂️

Every fluffy customer who sits in your chair has a story they want to share.

Become a barber in a city filled with animal residents. Between every snip and conversation, you’ll slowly get to know the customers sitting in your chair.

Sometimes, a new look really can change something.

The free Beastfolk Barber demo is now available on Steam. Pick up your scissors and meet today’s customers.

Your first customer is waiting—meet them in the free Steam demo: https://utm.to/9f949p

Beastfolk Barber is developed by Safe Flight Games, with development and publishing support from SIGONO.
